note: M2 milestone G (designed). `enabled`: the calibrated baseline plays without close calls (false); the app turns them on (prepareGame closeCalls). questions: the prompt per close-call kind. The average coach challenges a close call that went against it when reversalRate x valueSwing - (1 - reversalRate) x timeoutCost > threshold, where reversalRate is the fitted rate for the kind (data/game/challenges.json), valueSwing is the gain in its lead plus expected points of the next snap if the ruling is reversed (the step 5 penalty-choice value), and timeoutCost is what a lost timeout is worth to it, in points. It never sees the verdict.

questions.fumbleToDown: Was he down before the ball came out?
questions.spotLineToGain: Did he reach the line to gain?
